shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Smooth Squad Busters Gameplay 🎮💥
shortIntro.para1: Squad Busters is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter focused on real-time squad combat, map control, and ability-based encounters. The game combines stylized visuals with dynamic effects, explosions, and multiple on-screen players, making GPU stability and CPU efficiency essential for smooth gameplay.
shortIntro.para2: Fast aiming, instant skill activation, and squad coordination rely heavily on processor speed, touch sampling rate, and consistent frame delivery. Devices with balanced CPU–GPU performance and higher refresh-rate displays deliver a noticeable competitive advantage in intense matches.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended system requirements for Squad Busters on Android and iOS (2025-ready). These specifications are based on multiplayer stress tests, ranked matches, and long-session performance feedback from competitive players 🏆.

minimum.Internet: Stable low-latency connection required for multiplayer battles

recommended.Internet: Strong Wi-Fi or 5G for real-time squad coordination

ios_intro: Squad Busters runs exceptionally smoothly on iOS devices thanks to Apple’s Metal API, high touch sampling rates, and fast NVMe storage. This results in accurate aiming, instant ability triggers, and stable performance even in ability-heavy squad fights.

ios_recommended.title: Device
ios_recommended.value: iPhone X / XR / 11 Series or newer

fps_intro: Frame rate directly impacts aiming precision, camera smoothness, and reaction time. Higher FPS delivers smoother tracking and faster response during close-range squad engagements.
settings_intro: Optimized graphics and system settings help maintain stable FPS, reduce overheating, and improve control accuracy during intense firefights.

low_end.title: Graphics Quality
low_end.value: Low or Medium for stable frame rate

low_end.title: Effects
low_end.value: Disable motion blur and extra shadows

low_end.title: Background Apps
low_end.value: Close all background apps before playing

high_end.title: Thermal Control
high_end.value: Avoid charging while gaming to prevent throttling 🔥

high_end.title: Touch Optimization
high_end.value: Disable floating windows and game overlays

faqIntroText: Frequently asked questions about Squad Busters performance, FPS, and device optimization.

faqList.question: Is Squad Busters demanding on mobile devices?
faqList.answer: Yes. Real-time squads, abilities, and effects require strong CPU/GPU balance and enough RAM.

faqList.question: Does high refresh rate improve gameplay?
faqList.answer: Yes. 90Hz and 120Hz displays reduce motion blur and improve aiming accuracy.

faqList.question: Which devices are best for competitive play?
faqList.answer: Devices with Snapdragon 870+, iPhone 12+, and 6GB+ RAM offer the smoothest experience.
